title: "Ann Maria Carter Smith - Lucy and Christian Wainwright and Other Tales"
book_id: 31

## Publication Information

**Date:** 1863

**Imprint:** London: Masters

**Notes:** The title story originally appeared as 'Lucy and Christian Wainwright, or, The One Eternal Meeting, 1781' in <i>MP</i> (February 1856) 111-38.  The volume also includes ‘Some Thorns and Roses from a Homely Life’, ‘Bygone Days’, ‘A Household Record’, ‘The Two Beauties’, ‘Will No One do Likewise?’ and ‘The Lost are Found’.
